character: Largest ski resort in the Vosges massif. 30 runs, 21km, 15 lifts. Hohneck summit (1,363m). Night skiing (Tue/Fri 5-9pm, €15). Snowpark, 70% snowmaking. Blueberry picking in summer. Bike park. Lac des Corbeaux glacial lake.
description: La Bresse Hohneck is the largest ski resort in the Vosges, on the slopes of the Hohneck summit (1,363m). 30 runs (4 green, 8 blue, 12 red, 6 black), 15 lifts, 70% snowmaking. 3 sectors: Le Hohneck (panoramic reds, guided off-piste), La Vologne (family heart, snowpark, beginner zone), and a small linked domain. Night skiing Tuesday and Friday evenings (5-9pm, €15). Bike park with 7 downhill runs in summer. Lac des Corbeaux glacial lake loop walk. Blueberry picking on high meadows. Craft beer bar 'La Corne du Diable'. Nordic spa at Bains de Bien-Être. Day pass ~€42 adult.

non_ski_activities.night_skiing: Tuesday and Friday 5-9pm. 3 lit trails. €15. Family atmosphere, magical valley views.
non_ski_activities.bike_park: One of the best bike parks in the Vosges. Summer lift access. DH and enduro lines. 7 runs.
non_ski_activities.hohneck_summit: 1,363m — iconic Vosges summit. Views to the Alps on clear days. Hiking trails from La Bresse or La Schlucht.
non_ski_activities.lac_des_corbeaux: Glacial lake at 887m. 30-45 min forest walk. Free shuttle in summer. Swimming prohibited.
non_ski_activities.blueberry_picking: High meadow wild blueberries — a local summer tradition.
non_ski_activities.spa: Bains de Bien-Être — Nordic spa with sauna, outdoor nordic bath, massages.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowpark (La Vologne), cross-country skiing (Marcairie plateau), dog sledding, tree climbing park (age 3+), craft beer bar 'La Corne du Diable', Thursday producer market.
